sources.entry: Gaseous Server ⚠ - Game ROM manager with a built-in web-based emulator using multiple sources to identify and provide metadata. AGPL-3.0 Docker/.NET

summary.one_liner: Gaseous Server is the backend for the Gaseous system, a ROM and game title manager that also offers basic in-browser emulation of ROMs.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes the server as handling ROM and title management, plus some basic in-browser emulation of those ROMs. Version 1.7.0 and later include user authentication, so it can be exposed to the internet, though the README recommends against that unless remote access is needed and secured by other means such as a VPN. It requires a MariaDB (preferred) or MySQL 8+ database and ffmpeg. Metadata lookup uses an Internet Game Database API key unless the Hasheous proxy is used. Users can import signatures and add ROMs, with installation and usage details linked externally. The README also names EmulatorJS and RomM as related projects, and includes a test suite run with dotnet test.
use_cases: Organize and manage a ROM collection
Identify game ROMs and fetch metadata
Play ROMs in a web browser
Run a multi-user ROM server with login
notable: Built-in web-based emulator for in-browser ROM play
Uses multiple sources to identify ROMs and provide metadata, including the Hasheous proxy
Signature import to help identify ROMs
caveats: The README advises against exposing the server to the internet unless actively needed, and the authors accept no responsibility for doing so
Requires a MariaDB or MySQL database; moving from MySQL to MariaDB requires rebuilding the database from scratch
Browser emulation is described only as basic
